summary: The WelcomeStaffAdmin page provides an interface for staff administrators to review current site status and employment applications.
purpose: To facilitate staff administrators in managing site operations and reviewing employment applications.
business_rules: Dates must be valid and end date cannot precede start date.
Include withdrawn applications based on checkbox state.
validations: Date fields must be properly formatted.
Start date must be before end date.
system_behavior: Updates view dynamically based on site and discipline selection.
